classification.definition: Stored pipeline level 2: Gold membership, also included in Silver.

residue_series.definition: Mean DSSP relative solvent accessibility over a centered 25-residue window with reflected padding at sequence ends (producer disorder-25), rounded to three decimals. Higher values indicate greater accessibility used by AlphaFold-disorder to predict disorder. This is not 1 minus pLDDT or a calibrated disorder probability. Stored regions are retained separately.

AlphaFold-disorder binding-25-0.581 composite: let a be the centered 25-residue mean DSSP relative solvent accessibility with reflected end padding and p be pLDDT divided by 100. The score is a when a <= 0.581, otherwise 0.581 + (1 - 0.581) * p, rounded to three decimals. Higher scores identify accessible residues with local structural confidence as candidate linear interacting peptides. This is not a calibrated binding probability. Stored regions are retained separately.

AlphaFold per-residue pLDDT divided by 100, retained at the producer precision of three decimals. Higher values indicate higher local structural confidence. This stored scale is 0–1, not the conventional 0–100 pLDDT scale; it is not a disorder or binding probability.

annotation_sets.definition: UniProt MOD_RES annotations. Original evidence was not retained by the producer.
